title: 哥本哈根阿邁厄巴克焚化發電廠
summary: 把Amager Bakke拆成進料、燃燒、蒸汽、熱電、煙氣及灰渣六條證據鏈；公共空間外觀與工廠環境績效分開驗證。
summaryEn: Divide Amager Bakke into evidence chains for feed, combustion, steam, energy, flue gas and ash; assess public-space appearance separately from environmental performance.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 垃圾進料質量帳：地磅淨重與物流配對：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Waste-feed mass ledger: Weighbridge net mass and matched consignments: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 垃圾進料質量帳：地磅淨重與物流配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Waste-feed mass ledger: Weighbridge net mass and matched consignments and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同一車次總重減空車重得到淨入料；班次總量需以唯一車次編號去重，才能與灰渣、儲坑庫存及能源帳相連。本單元在「垃圾進料質量帳」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Gross minus tare mass for one consignment gives net feed; deduplicated trip IDs connect shift totals to ash, bunker inventory and energy ledgers. Examine this relationship at waste-feed mass ledger.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一車次總重18.6 t、空車重7.4 t。公式 mnet=mgross-mtare；代入 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t。適用邊界：僅適用同一車輛及相容含水狀態；燃料、乘員與附著水變化另計。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross mass18.6 t and tare7.4 t for the same trip. Formula mnet=mgross-mtare; substitution 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t. Boundary: The same vehicle and compatible moisture basis are required; fuel, occupants and retained water changes are separate.
steps.failure: 重複匯入車次或使用不同車輛空重會虛增進料；先封存原始票據再重算。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Duplicate trips or the wrong vehicle tare inflate feed; preserve raw tickets and recompute. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 核對車次編號、兩次秤重時間與零點檢查，再比對儲坑日末庫存。在離線場景為「垃圾進料質量帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Match trip ID, both weighing times and zero checks, then reconcile closing bunker stock. Build an offline evidence table for waste-feed mass ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 垃圾進料質量帳：地磅淨重與物流配對
knowledge.titleEn: Waste-feed mass ledger: Weighbridge net mass and matched consignments
knowledge.text: 同一車次總重減空車重得到淨入料；班次總量需以唯一車次編號去重，才能與灰渣、儲坑庫存及能源帳相連。本單元在「垃圾進料質量帳」觀察此因果關係。
knowledge.textEn: Gross minus tare mass for one consignment gives net feed; deduplicated trip IDs connect shift totals to ash, bunker inventory and energy ledgers. Examine this relationship at waste-feed mass ledger.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「垃圾進料質量帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把總重改成20.1 t，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 12.7 t。與基準 11.2 t比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the waste-feed mass ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gross mass to20.1 t with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 12.7 t. Compare with baseline 11.2 t and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
One constant tare applies to every collection vehicle.

quiz.explanationEn: Gross minus tare mass for one consignment gives net feed; deduplicated trip IDs connect shift totals to ash, bunker inventory and energy ledgers. Match trip ID, both weighing times and zero checks, then reconcile closing bunker stock. Build an offline evidence table for waste-feed mass ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
